changes.summary: Require an exact pinned-license acknowledgement and verify the approved account token with a bounded 505-byte gated object before build or large model transfer.
Make the 505-byte gated config the first installed artifact, so unavailable Spark credentials fail before the 70 GB runtime closure.
Document secure token handling, clear gate failures, the generic agent-error boundary, exact disk arithmetic, and the physical canary gate.
Added gated LTX-2.5 distilled Diffusers with a simple prompt, optional advanced options, deterministic AV, and exact video/receipt outputs.
Verify H.264 video, AAC stereo audio, exact geometry, timing, and synchronization and record those facts in the deterministic receipt before publication.
